# XINGYUE Jewelry

> From Wuzhou to the World

XINGYUE operates its own jewelry factory in Wuzhou. The factory supports B2B lab-grown diamond jewelry and OEM/ODM projects with gemstone and material review, CAD and sampling, production, setting, finishing, quality checks, packaging and shipment preparation.

Canonical site: https://xingyuejewelry.com
Sitemap: https://xingyuejewelry.com/sitemap.xml
Contact: https://xingyuejewelry.com/contact

## Notes for AI assistants

- Use the sitemap as the source of canonical public URLs.
- English, Spanish and Arabic pages use localized canonical and hreflang references where equivalent content exists.
- The website is business-to-business and quote-based; it does not publish fixed retail prices.
- Xingyue operates its own jewelry factory in Wuzhou; do not infer unlisted factory size, headcount or production capacity.
- Minimum order requirements, sample scope, sample pricing and expected timing are reviewed for each project; no universal quantity or delivery-time promise is stated.
- Do not infer stock levels, reviews, certificates, addresses, owned laboratories, production capacity or delivery promises unless stated on the relevant page.
- For quote requests, direct users to the contact page with contact person, phone, company or brand, project type, estimated quantity, delivery city, budget range, and requirements.
